sentences.zh: 我们先从民主党开始。

sentences.en: I thought the poll was pretty clarifying on what divides Democrats and maybe more importantly what really doesn't.
sentences.zh: 我认为这项民调非常清晰地指出了是什么在分裂民主党，或许更重要的是，什么其实并没有分裂他们。

sentences.en: You know, in the elite discourse since Kamala Harris' defeat in 2024,
sentences.zh: 你知道，自从卡玛拉·哈里斯在2024年落败以来，在精英阶层的舆论场中，

sentences.en: Democratic wonks and activists and policymakers have been arguing about whether the Democrats should move toward the center
sentences.zh: 民主党的智囊、活动人士和政策制定者一直在争论，民主党究竟应该向中间路线靠拢，

sentences.en: or embrace a more progressive left-wing kind of politics.
sentences.zh: 还是拥抱更加进步主义的左翼政治。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But the poll didn't really show a ton of dissatisfaction on ideological lines.
sentences.zh: 但民调并没有真正显示出意识形态层面的海量不满。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: Democrats basically thought that they were okay with where the party was.
sentences.zh: 民主党人基本上认为他们对党目前的现状感到满意。

sentences.en: A majority of Democrats say that the party's not too far to the left or too far to the center.
sentences.zh: 多数民主党人表示，该党既没有过于偏左，也没有过于偏向中间。

sentences.en: Only 20% either way say the party is too far to the left or too far to the right.
sentences.zh: 只有20%的人（无论持哪种观点）认为该党过于偏左或过于偏右。

sentences.en: That's quite notable because we think of the Democratic brand as being really damaged,
sentences.zh: 这非常值得注意，因为我们总觉得民主党的招牌已经严重受损，

sentences.en: but this poll is suggesting when it comes to ideology and positions, that's not what voters see as the damage.
sentences.zh: 但这项民调表明，就意识形态和立场而言，这并不是选民眼中受损的地方。

sentences.en: At least not within the Democratic Party, to be clear.
sentences.zh: 至少在民主党内部不是这样，需要澄清这一点。

sentences.en: We're talking about voters who lean Democratic.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是倾向于民主党的选民。

sentences.en: So it's possible that there are lost Trump voters, for instance, who wouldn't have been captured here, who are upset about the Democratic Party's position.
sentences.zh: 因此，可能会有一些失落的特朗普选民（例如在此未被捕捉到的选民）对民主党的立场感到不满。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But among those who are in the Democratic coalition, they're not that upset about the party's ideological positioning.
sentences.zh: 但在民主党联盟内部的选民中，他们对党的意识形态定位并不是那么不满。

sentences.en: They are, however, dissatisfied with the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们确实对民主党感到不满。

sentences.en: And the clearest reason for that is because they don't think that the party has succeeded in stopping Trump, whether that's in Washington or in the last campaign.
sentences.zh: 最明显的原因是，他们认为该党没有成功阻止特朗普，无论是在华盛顿还是在上一场竞选中。

sentences.en: So what upsets them is their perception of their party's leaders as ineffective encountering Trump,
sentences.zh: 因此，让他们感到沮丧的是，他们觉得党内领导人在应对特朗普时显得软弱无能，

sentences.en: even though it does feel like Democratic leaders over the past few months have tried to do that,
sentences.zh: 尽管过去几个月民主党领导层似乎确实尝试过这么做，

sentences.en: shutting down the government over health care costs, shutting down the government over immigration tactics.
sentences.zh: 为了医疗保健成本关闭政府，为了移民策略关闭政府。

sentences.en: It's not enough.
sentences.zh: 这还不够。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, when you hone in on that group of Democrats who say they're dissatisfied with the party,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你把焦点缩小到那群自称对党感到不满的民主党人时，

sentences.en: more than three quarters of them say that they don't think that the Democratic Party is doing enough to fight back against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 超过四分之三的人表示，他们认为民主党在对抗唐纳德·特朗普方面做得还不够。

sentences.en: Now, I think it's reasonable to say that the Democrats don't have that many opportunities to fight back against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为可以说民主党对抗唐纳德·特朗普的机会并没有那么多，这是合情合理的。

sentences.en: And I think it's also worth wondering how much of this is still about the Democrats' failure to stop him from winning power in the first place.
sentences.zh: 而且我也觉得值得深思的是，这里面究竟有多少成分仍然在归咎于民主党最初未能阻止他赢得权力。

sentences.en: I think this can just this question be a proxy for a broader sense that the party has failed in the central mission over the last 10 years,
sentences.zh: 我认为这个问题可以作为一种替代指标，反映出人们更广泛的一种感觉：该党在过去10年的核心使命上失败了，

sentences.en: which is stopping Donald Trump's presidency.
sentences.zh: 这个使命就是阻止唐纳德·特朗普的总统任期。

sentences.zh: 所以，如果你把选民的这种不满放在更广泛的背景下来看，其实是相当容易理解的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There aren't like issues where they want the Democrats to embrace the conservative view on, say, transgender issues or something like that.

sentences.zh: 他们以近三比一的巨大优势表示，更希望看到党去打击企业垄断。

sentences.zh: 我们能不能推出一位能够弥合我们分歧、让我们所有人团结在他身后的候选人？

sentences.en: Can we come up with a candidate who bridges our divides, who we can all rally behind?
sentences.zh: 然后才是这位候选人能否在大选中取得成功的问题。

sentences.en: And then there's a question of whether that candidate can succeed in the general election.
sentences.zh: 我确实碰巧认为，我们一直在讨论的这些特质的结合——

sentences.en: I do happen to think that the combination of attributes that we've been talking about,
sentences.zh: 经济民粹主义、淡化文化议题以及反对以色列——在2028年对年轻的黑人选民和拉丁裔选民来说都会非常管用。

sentences.en: economic populism, de-emphasis on cultural issues, and opposition to Israel would play pretty well with all of young Black and Latino voters in 2028.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，该党目前试图解决的核心任务是一个内部任务，它甚至先于如何争取大选中的选民这一问题。

sentences.en: But I think that the core task that the party is trying to solve for right now is an internal one that even precedes how to try and win over voters in the general election.
sentences.zh: 换个例子来看，共和党人已经为自己解决了这些问题，对吧？

sentences.en: To take a different example, the Republicans have solved these problems for themselves, right?
sentences.zh: 他们想成为唐纳德·特朗普的政党，这可能会让他们输掉2026年和2028年的选举，但他们很清楚自己是谁。

sentences.en: They want to be the party of Donald Trump, and that may cost them the 2026 and 2028 election, but they know who they are.
sentences.zh: 好吧，既然你开始谈论方程中共和党的那一部分，我们就把这个想法补充完整吧。

sentences.en: Okay, well, since you're starting to do the Republican side of this equation, let's complete that thought.
sentences.zh: 既然共和党人相当团结，并且一致认为他们的党是特朗普的党、一致支持特朗普的议程，那么这项民调暴露出共和党内部存在哪些裂痕？

sentences.en: What are the fractures within the Republican party that this poll exposes, knowing that Republicans are pretty unified
sentences.zh: 在我们讨论分歧之前，让我们首先重申最后一点。

sentences.en: and agree that their party is Trump's party and about Trump's agenda?
sentences.zh: 共和党在唐纳德·特朗普身后大体上是团结的。

sentences.en: Let's just start by reiterating that last point before we go into the divisions.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅认可唐纳德·特朗普今天作为总统的表现，还希望下一任共和党总统候选人追随唐纳德·特朗普的领导，

sentences.en: The Republican party is mostly unified behind Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而不是走向新的方向。

sentences.en: Not only do they approve of Donald Trump's performance as president today, they also would like the next Republican candidate for president to follow Donald Trump's lead
sentences.zh: 并且在我们询问的所有议题上，他们都希望追随唐纳德·特朗普的领导。

sentences.en: rather than go in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里的总体情况在共和党这一侧要比在民主党那一侧清晰得多。

sentences.en: And they want to follow Donald Trump's lead on every issue that we asked about.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，共和党内确实存在一小部分意义重大的少数派，他们不认可总统的行事风格，

sentences.en: So the overarching story here is much clearer on the Republican side than it is on the Democratic side.
sentences.zh: 并且希望看到共和党总统候选人走向新的方向。

sentences.en: And that said, there is a meaningful minority of Republicans who don't approve the president's conduct
sentences.zh: 这些选民不成比例地由年轻人和非白人组成。

sentences.en: and who would like to see the Republican presidential candidate go in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 事实上，民调中18至44岁人群的多数派希望看到下一任共和党总统带领该党走向新的方向。

sentences.en: These voters are disproportionately young and non-white.
sentences.zh: 而且多数非白人共和党人希望看到下一位总统候选人带领该党走向新的方向。

sentences.en: And in fact, a majority of 18 to 44-year-olds in the poll want to see the next Republican president take the party in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 他们以二比一的巨大优势表达了这一观点。

sentences.en: And a majority of non-white Republicans want to see the next presidential candidate take the party in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 在具体议题上，生活成本和外交政策似乎是不满情绪的关键点。

sentences.en: And they say so by wide two-to-one margins.
sentences.zh: 因此，这与你可能还记得的2016年所谓的“永不特朗普派”对唐纳德·特朗普的反对有着非常不同的性质，

sentences.en: On the issues, it seems pretty clear that the cost of living and foreign policy are crucial points of discontent.
sentences.zh: 当年那些人反对唐纳德·特朗普，是因为他是个孤立主义者、反对自由贸易且反对全面的移民改革。

sentences.en: So this is a very different kind of opposition to Donald Trump than the one that you might remember from the so-called never-Trumpers back in 2016,
sentences.zh: 因此，来自年轻和非白人共和党人的这种新型不满，在许多情况下是因为他并未完全兑现

sentences.en: who opposed Donald Trump because he was an isolationist and opposed free trade and opposed comprehensive immigration reform.
sentences.zh: 用他自己的话说，即把美国放在首位的承诺。

sentences.en: So this new kind of dissatisfaction from young and non-white Republicans is in many cases because he hasn't necessarily followed through
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: with his promise to put America first, as he would put it.
sentences.zh: 相反，他已经从2016年的孤立主义者变成了干涉主义者，并挑起了中东战争，

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 而他当初正是通过宣称自己绝不会追求这样的战争，才极其成功地将年轻的非白人选民吸引到共和党阵营中的。

sentences.en: Instead, he has gone from being an isolationist back in 2016 to becoming an interventionist and starting the very kind of war in the Middle East
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: that he very successfully lured young non-white voters to the Republican Party by saying he would never pursue.
sentences.zh: 而且再次强调，这里的代沟非常明显。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 在所有外交政策议题上，44岁以下的年轻共和党人往往以二比一甚至更高的巨大优势与他背道而驰。

sentences.en: And again, the generational divide here is really stark.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我还要指出，这其中也包括共和党人对以色列的支持问题。

sentences.en: On all of the foreign policy issues, young Republicans under age 44, they line up against him and often by wide two-to-one or more margins.
sentences.zh: 多数年轻共和党人认为唐纳德·特朗普对以色列过于支持，并反对他处理以巴冲突的方式。

sentences.en: I'll also note, by the way, that that includes the question of Republican support for Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以这与我们以往从共和党人那里看到的景象大不相同。

sentences.en: A majority of young Republicans think that Donald Trump is too supportive of Israel and disapprove of his handling of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，这恰好呼应了我们在共和党精英舆论场所看到的一些现象。

sentences.en: So that's very different from what we've seen before from Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我们看到像塔克·卡尔森（Tucker Carlson）、乔·罗根（Joe Rogan）甚至尼克·富恩特斯（Nick Fuentes）这样知名的播客主，在以色列问题以及特朗普的外交政策上持这些立场，

sentences.en: And I will say that it happens to echo something we have seen in the elite discourse among Republicans.
sentences.zh: 而这些立场我们在年轻共和党人的公众舆论中也能得到呼应。

sentences.en: We've seen prominent podcasters like Tucker Carlson or Joe Rogan or even Nick Fuentes take these positions on Israel and Trump's foreign policy
sentences.zh: 内特，我们花了大量时间讨论这两党内部的分歧以及这群关键选民（尤其是年轻的非白人选民），

sentences.en: that we can see echoed in public opinion among younger Republicans.
sentences.zh: 讨论究竟哪个党派的信息能把他们争取过来。

sentences.en: Nate, we're spending a lot of time talking about divisions within these two parties and this key group of voters, especially young non-white voters,
sentences.zh: 但我根据过去多年与你交谈的经验突然想到，如果我们有一位支持率如此之低的总统，

sentences.en: what message from either party could bring them in.
sentences.zh: 这种对话可能就没那么重要了。

sentences.en: But it occurs to me, based on past conversations I've had with you over the years, that that conversation might not be hugely relevant
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，这些数字可能还会继续下跌。

sentences.en: if we have a president whose approval numbers are this low.
sentences.zh: 我这样想对吗？

sentences.en: And those numbers, as you said earlier, might continue to fall.
sentences.zh: 如果你所说的“重要”是指对决定哪个党派赢得2028年大选重要……

sentences.en: Am I right in thinking that?
sentences.zh: 你完全理解我的意思。

sentences.en: If by relevant you mean relevant to determining which party wins the 2028 general election...
sentences.zh: ……那么我认为你的观点很合理。

sentences.en: You read me correctly.
sentences.zh: 如果总统的支持率跌至40%以下，那么民主党人在2028年获胜的胜算就会相当明显。

sentences.en: ...then I think you have a fair point.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: If the president's approval rating is under 40, the Democrats would be pretty clearly favored to win in 2028.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: There's no precedent for the president's party retaining the White House when his approval rating is under 40%, let alone even lower than that.
sentences.zh: 当总统的支持率低于40%，更不用说还要更低时，总统所在的政党想要保住白宫是没有先例的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And I think the clearest example of that in recent memory is what happened to George W.
sentences.zh: 我认为近期最明显的例子就是小乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush.
sentences.zh: 布什。

sentences.en: I mean, at almost this exact time, 20 years ago,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，差不多就在20年前的这个时候，

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 小乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush's approval rating fell under 40% to about the number where Donald Trump is today, thanks to a combination of quagmire in the Middle East and high gas prices.
sentences.zh: 布什的支持率跌破了40%，降到了大约和今天唐纳德·特朗普差不多的水平，这主要是因为中东泥潭和高油价的双重打击。

sentences.en: And while it took a while, his ratings kept falling and ultimately landed in the 20s.
sentences.zh: 虽然经历了一段时间，但他的支持率持续下跌，最终落在了20%多。

sentences.en: And the Democrats, of course, won decisively in the 2008 general election.
sentences.zh: 而民主党人当然在2008年的大选中取得了压倒性胜利。

sentences.en: Barack Obama won by seven points, and they came out of that election with a nearly filibuster-proof majority in the Senate and a large majority in the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马以七个百分点的优势获胜，他们在参议院获得了几乎可以阻止冗长辩论的多数席位，并在众议院占据了绝对多数。

sentences.en: Now, obviously, this is a more polarized era.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一个两极分化更严重的时代。

sentences.en: Whether the Democrats can appeal as broadly as Barack Obama did in 2008 is an open question.
sentences.zh: 民主党能否像2008年的贝拉克·奥巴马那样获得广泛支持，还是个未知数。

sentences.en: But when the president's approval rating starts sinking lower than the 40s and you start giving up traditional Republican-leaning voters,
sentences.zh: 但当总统的支持率开始跌破40%大关，并且你开始失去传统倾向于共和党的选民时，

sentences.en: the opportunities for a more decisive Democratic victory start to come into view.
sentences.zh: 民主党取得更决定性胜利的机会就开始显现出来了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I just want to end on a simple observation.
sentences.zh: 我只想以一个简单的观察来结束。

sentences.en: Normally, this would be the moment for people inside a party like the one Trump leads to look around, especially in Congress, and say, man, this is not going well.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，对于像特朗普领导的这种政党内部的人来说，现在应该是环顾四周的时候，尤其是在国会，然后说，天哪，这进展不顺利。

sentences.en: And they would start to break with the president.
sentences.zh: 他们会开始与总统决裂。

sentences.en: They would start to resist his agenda in areas like the war in Iran where it's clear broadly, nationally, voters don't like what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 他们会开始在诸如伊朗战争等明显在全国范围内不讨选民喜欢的领域抵制他的议程。

sentences.en: But what is so singular about Trump is that his hold over the party through these primaries where he's pushing out anyone who ever resists him
sentences.zh: 但特朗普的独一无二之处在于，他通过这次初选对党派的绝对掌控——他在初选中排挤了任何曾反抗过他的人——

sentences.en: means that everyone is holding on to the same steering wheel that he is in this moment.
sentences.zh: 这意味着此时此刻每个人都和他握着同一个方向盘。

sentences.en: And they're all, and I used this metaphor earlier this week in a different episode, kind of driving the car towards the same electoral cliff it would seem.
sentences.zh: 他们都在——我在本周早些时候的另一期节目里用过这个比喻——开着车冲向同一个选举悬崖。

sentences.en: I think that's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对正确。

sentences.en: I mentioned earlier that a majority of Republicans want to follow Donald Trump's lead in 2028 rather than go in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 我刚才提到过，多数共和党人希望在2028年继续追随唐纳德·特朗普的领导，而不是走一条新路线。

sentences.en: Well, the general electorate wants a new direction by a three-to-one margin.
sentences.zh: 然而，广大选民却以三比一的比例希望走一条新路线。

sentences.en: That's a big disconnect between the general electorate's desires and what the Republican Party is about to give the general electorate.
sentences.zh: 广大选民的愿望与共和党即将带给他们的东西之间存在着巨大的脱节。

sentences.en: And, you know, for all of the talk about the challenges facing the Democratic Party, that mismatch seems like the biggest one to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽管人们一直在讨论民主党面临的挑战，但在我看来，这种错位才是最大的挑战。

sentences.en: We've had change election after change election over the last two decades.
sentences.zh: 在过去的二十家里，我们经历了一次又一次的求变选举。

sentences.en: If the Republican Party really wants to serve the general electorate the same thing again, I think that they would be in a lot of trouble in 26 and 28.
sentences.zh: 如果共和党真的想再次把同样的东西端给全体选民，我认为他们在26年和28年将会遇到大麻烦。

sentences.en: Well, Nate, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，内特，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Thursday evening, after we spoke with Nate, congressional Republicans finally seemed to lose their patience with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 周四晚上，在我们与内特交谈后，国会共和党人似乎终于失去了对特朗普总统的耐心。

sentences.en: Republican senators staged a rare rebellion against the president's $1.8 billion compensation fund, which could pay his political allies, including January 6th rioters.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员罕见地对总统价值18亿美元的补偿基金发起了叛乱，该基金可能会用于支付他的政治盟友，包括1月6日的骚乱者。

sentences.en: I think it's stupid on stilts.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这蠢到家了。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because it will invariably put us in a position where your taxpayer dollars and my taxpayer dollars could potentially compensate someone who assaulted a police officer,
sentences.zh: 因为这不可避免地会让我们陷入这样一种境地：你的纳税人钱和我的纳税人钱可能会去补偿一个殴打警察的人，

sentences.en: admitted their guilt, got convicted, got pardoned, and now we're going to pay them for that?
sentences.zh: 他承认了罪行，被定罪，得到了赦免，而现在我们还要为此付钱给他？

sentences.en: That's absurd.
sentences.zh: 这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: To protest the controversial fund, Republican senators refused to vote on a bill to finance Trump's crackdown on illegal immigration, which was scheduled for Thursday evening.
sentences.zh: 为了抗议这个备受争议的基金，共和党参议员拒绝就原定于周四晚上进行表决的、旨在资助特朗普打击非法移民的法案投票。

sentences.en: Shortly after, reporters asked the president about the rebellion at the White House.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，记者在白宫向总统询问了这场叛乱。

sentences.en: Are you losing control of the Senate, Senate Republicans?
sentences.zh: 你是在失去对参议院、对参议院共和党人的控制吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I really don't know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: I can tell you.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你。

sentences.en: I only do what's right.
sentences.zh: 我只做正确的事。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Democratic National Committee released a draft of an internal autopsy of what went wrong in the 2024 presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 周四，民主党全国委员会发布了一份内部复盘报告的草案，分析了2024年总统竞选究竟哪里出了问题。

sentences.en: It found that President Biden had failed to position Kamala Harris for success by the time he dropped out of the race,
sentences.zh: 报告发现，拜登总统在退选时没能为卡玛拉·哈里斯的成功奠定基础，

sentences.en: that Harris failed to distance herself from Biden's damaged brand, and that Trump's attacks on Harris's past positions,
sentences.zh: 哈里斯未能将自己与拜登受损的品牌形象拉开距离，而且特朗普对哈里斯过去立场的攻击——

sentences.en: especially her liberal approach to transgender rights, had been highly effective.
sentences.zh: 尤其是她在跨性别权益问题上的自由派立场——取得了极高的成效。

sentences.en: In the end, the report said,
sentences.zh: 报告称，到头来，

sentences.en: The Harris campaign failed to make a strong enough case to Americans to vote for Harris, rather than just against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯的竞选团队未能向美国人提出强有力的理由，让他们去投票支持哈里斯，而不仅仅是为了反对特朗普总统。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由玛丽·威尔逊、克里斯·本德雷斯和穆吉·萨迪制作。

sentences.zh: 由帕特里夏·威兰斯和雷切尔·奎斯特剪辑，并包含罗文·埃米斯托、丹·鲍威尔和马里恩·洛扎诺的音乐。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会一觉睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
